    short_name,
    team_name,
    team_colour,
    gap_to_fastest_pct,

    avg(gap_to_fastest_pct) over (partition by team_name) as season_avg_gap_pct

queries.compiledQueryString:
select team_name, any_value(team_colour) as team_colour, round(avg(gap_to_fastest_pct), 3) as avg_gap_pct,
       count(*) filter (gap_to_fastest_pct = 0) as times_fastest
from (select
    round_number,
    short_name,
    team_name,
    team_colour,
    gap_to_fastest_pct,
    gap_to_fastest_s,
    avg(gap_to_fastest_pct) over (partition by team_name) as season_avg_gap_pct
from f1.team_session_pace
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
  and session_name = '${inputs.mode}'
order by round_number)
group by team_name
order by avg_gap_pct
